suitePurpose: Supplemental control-only challenge set, not a final accuracy corpus
selectionRule: Exact historical releases chosen by intended legitimate capability before any scanner output was inspected; all acquired controls retained even if scanning later fails or is partial.
limitations: All ten entries are provisionally benign; this set measures known control alerts, not recall or general ecosystem false-positive rate.
Chosen by capability before outputs, with original bytes and explicit provenance; no exclusion based on subsequent results.
Known ordinary security vulnerabilities do not convert a package into a malicious package. These historical releases are data inputs, not install recommendations.
All entries use split=test only for the harness contract. The six-version pilot remains a separate regression corpus and is not merged into held-out accuracy claims.
Partial or failed scans remain selected in the denominator and must be reported separately.
